items.prompt: rain that fell on the hills is lying in (31) ........ under the surface
items.evidence: rain that fell on high ground sits in gravel below the surface
items.explanation: At the point where the high ground meets the plain, rain that fell higher up collects in gravel below the surface.

items.prompt: dig a tunnel back towards the well, rising at roughly one in (32) ........
items.evidence: the surveys put them nearer one in two thousand
items.explanation: One in a thousand is the textbook figure, an average taken across channels of every length; the channels in the region the speaker works on are far longer than average and the surveys put them nearer one in two thousand.

yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Turn 2 icinde deger degistirildi: ders kitabi rakami (one in a thousand) artik acikca soylenen celdirici, dogru cevap konusmacinin kendi bolgesindeki uzun kanallar icin verdigi olcum (one in two thousand). 'one in a hundred' cok dik ornegi olarak yerinde kaldi. Kalip 'one in a ___' iken 'one in ___' oldu, cunku cevap artik iki sozcuk. answer_point_id (L2-S4-01) ve turn_index (2) degismedi; ayni turdaki L2-S4-02 ve L2-S4-03 cumleleri (alistirma 5. soru bunlardan birine bagli) harfiyen korundu.
